$comment: SealLink v1.0 Structured Capability & Constraint Algebra Registry (SPEC-01, SPEC-06). All 7 predicates have linear-time decidable conservative subsumption (child <= parent) with zero Turing-completeness. Standard quota kinds define exact deterministic reservation and settlement rules.

predicates.narrowing_rule: child.op == 'eq' and type(child.operand) == type(parent.operand) and child.operand == parent.operand
predicates.description: Exact equality against a scalar argument value (no int/bool/string coercion).

predicates.match_rule: isinstance(arg, str) and arg in operand
predicates.narrowing_rule: (child.op == 'in' and set(child.operand) <= set(parent.operand)) or (child.op == 'eq' and isinstance(child.operand, str) and child.operand in set(parent.operand))
predicates.description: Finite allowlist of exact permitted string values.

predicates.match_rule: isinstance(arg, str) and arg not in operand
predicates.narrowing_rule: (child.op == 'not_in' and set(parent.operand) <= set(child.operand)) or (child.op == 'in' and set(child.operand).isdisjoint(set(parent.operand))) or (child.op == 'eq' and isinstance(child.operand, str) and child.operand not in set(parent.operand))
predicates.description: Finite denylist of forbidden string values (rejects non-string arguments).

predicates.narrowing_rule: (child.op == 'prefix' and child.operand.startswith(parent.operand)) or (child.op == 'eq' and isinstance(child.operand, str) and child.operand.startswith(parent.operand)) or (child.op == 'in' and all(v.startswith(parent.operand) for v in child.operand))
predicates.description: Exact code-point prefix match (canonical normalized paths, git refs, URI hierarchies).

predicates.narrowing_rule: (child.op == 'suffix' and child.operand.endswith(parent.operand)) or (child.op == 'eq' and isinstance(child.operand, str) and child.operand.endswith(parent.operand)) or (child.op == 'in' and all(v.endswith(parent.operand) for v in child.operand))
predicates.description: Exact code-point suffix match (lowercase DNS domains, single addr-spec email/XMPP addresses).

operand_types: [uint64_str min, uint64_str max] with 0 <= min <= max <= 2^64-1
arg_types: uint64_str (canonical unsigned 64-bit decimal string) or uint53 JSON integer
predicates.match_rule: (isinstance(arg, int) and not isinstance(arg, bool) and 0 <= arg <= 2^53-1 or is_canonical_uint64_str(arg)) and int(min) <= int(arg) <= int(max)
predicates.narrowing_rule: (child.op == 'range' and int(parent.min) <= int(child.min) <= int(child.max) <= int(parent.max)) or (child.op == 'eq' and is_canonical_uint64_str(child.operand) and int(parent.min) <= int(child.operand) <= int(parent.max)) or (child.op == 'in' and all(is_canonical_uint64_str(v) and int(parent.min) <= int(v) <= int(parent.max) for v in child.operand))
predicates.description: Closed unsigned 64-bit integer interval [min, max] over canonical uint64_str or non-negative uint53 integer argument values (no booleans, no floats, no leading zeros, no trailing newlines).

arg_types: string (lowercase Hex64 digest OR raw UTF-8 string whose SHA-256 equals operand)
predicates.match_rule: isinstance(arg, str) and ((is_hex64(arg) and arg == operand) or SHA256(arg.encode('utf-8')).hex() == operand)
predicates.description: Exact 32-byte SHA-256 commitment match: matches either a precomputed lowercase Hex64 digest argument (e.g., body_sha256, config_sha256) or raw UTF-8 bytes hashing to operand.

quota_windows.description: Cumulative ceiling across the entire grant validity window.
Half-open block windows [anchor + k*N, anchor + (k+1)*N) where own account uses leaf grant not_before_height and row account uses parent grant not_before_height.
UTC epoch-aligned fixed clock windows with durable regression watermark.

standard_quota_kinds.reserve_formula: 0 if (action == 'agent/session' and unit == 'starts' and arguments.get('op') in ('checkpoint', 'halt')) else 1
standard_quota_kinds.settlement: actual_release_remainder (0 <= actual <= reserve; actual > reserve refuses QUOTA_EXCEEDED)
